subject: Q2 terminal offer: token allocation to accelerate pilot-to-paid
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Jiang <olivia@hawkai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Q2 terminal offer: token allocation to accelerate pilot-to-paid

Hi Olivia,

Congrats again on the progress integrating Redwood — the proof-of-concept looks solid. As we're coming up on the end of Q2, the sales team has one-time discretionary capacity we can use to help close pilots that are production-ready but need a little runway to convert.

We can extend a one-off token allocation (non-recurring) to cover additional inference usage for up to 90 days so your engineers can finish the latency tuning and run the expanded dataset. Proposed allocation: 500k inference tokens (applies to text-gen only). Terms: expires 90 days from activation, non-transferable, billed only on overage thereafter. I'll attach a short allocation worksheet.

Next steps: can you confirm:
- whether 90 days covers your integration plan
- if procurement prefers a PO or DocuSign
- any compliance evidence you need (SOC2, data residency)

If this looks good I'll loop in finance for final sign-off and send terms.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(priyom.das@redwoodinference.com)
Attachment: allocation_details.xlsx (worksheet)

From: Olivia Jiang <olivia@hawkai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@hawkai.com
Date: 2026-04-28T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 terminal offer: token allocation to accelerate pilot-to-paid

Thanks Priyom — this is promising.

A few quick questions before we loop in procurement:
- Can the allocation be scoped to our staging project only? We want to ensure production usage isn't consumed by the promo.
- Do the tokens carry over if unused at 90 days?
- Any paperwork we need to sign for internal audit? We will need written terms that our procurement team can review.

Procurement: procurement@hawkai.com, can you advise preferred route for accepting (PO vs signed amendment)?

On Tue, Apr 28, 2026 at 10:05 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Olivia,
> 
> Congrats again on the progress integrating Redwood — the proof-of-concept looks solid. ...

Best,
Olivia

olivia@hawkai.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Jiang <olivia@hawkai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-28T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 terminal offer: token allocation to accelerate pilot-to-paid

Hi Olivia — great questions.

Short answers:
- Yes, we can scope the allocation to a single project identifier (staging) and enforce via API keys/route.
- Tokens do not carry over past 90 days; unused tokens will be forfeited (we can consider a one-time 30-day extension but would need finance sign-off).
- We'll provide a short amendment (one page) that procurement can sign; no change to your main SOW. I'm attaching the draft terms.

Looping in Marissa from finance for final authorization — Marissa, can you approve a 500k token discretionary allocation on DEAL-4921? If finance needs a different number we can adjust.

Priyom

Attachment: allocation_terms.pdf (draft amendment)

---

Priyom — approved.

Finance signs off on a one-time 400k token allocation (reduced from requested 500k) tied to DEAL-4921. Terms: 90-day expiry, scoped to staging API key, forfeiture of unused tokens. If HawkAI requests an extension beyond 90 days we'll require a business justification and a small refundable deposit to cover potential exploitation.

Priyom: please prepare the DocuSign amendment using the attached eoq_token_alloc_v1.pdf and confirm procurement contact so we can route the invoice if needed.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: eoq_token_alloc_v1.pdf (DocuSign-ready)

Thanks Marissa + Priyom — HawkAI accepts the 400k token allocation under the terms.

Procurement@hawkai.com: please prepare any PO if needed; otherwise we can sign the DocuSign.

Priyom: please send DocuSign and a short invoice/cover note so our accounting team can expedite payment on any refundable deposit if required.

Looking forward to moving to production.

Olivia
